step.action: Put belongings with no nearby owner found on, under, or around 📦 Communal_Tables in 📦 Lost_and_Found.
Use 🍳 Dustpan_and_Brush to brush dry crumbs and debris from 📦 Communal_Tables into the dustpan.
Inspect 📦 Communal_Tables for food, visible dirt, or sticky residue.
step.ifThen: IF food, visible dirt, or sticky residue remains, THEN do steps 5 through 7. IF none remains, THEN skip to step 8.

step.action: Wipe the sprayed areas with a towel from 🍳 Disposable_Towels until no food, visible dirt, or sticky residue remains.
Put the used towel in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Put remaining MOOP found on, under, and around 📦 Communal_Tables in 📦 Trash_Bins.

passWhen.criterion: No food, visible dirt, or sticky residue remains on the tables.
No MOOP remains on, under, or around the tables.

reasoning.entry: Move belongings with no nearby owner before cleaning so they are not brushed aside or discarded.
Remove dry debris before wet cleaning so cleaner and towels are used only when residue remains.
Finish with MOOP so the final sweep catches material displaced during cleaning.

decision.text: Use the sequence clear belongings, dry-brush, conditionally spot-clean, then collect MOOP.
decision.effect: Require 🍳 Dustpan_and_Brush as a resource. Use 🍳 Multisurface_Cleaner and 🍳 Disposable_Towels only when residue remains.

decision.text: Use the brush and dustpan on tables only when both have no visible dirt or trash.
decision.effect: Use disposable towels for dry debris when the brush or dustpan is not clean enough for a table surface.
